result.summary: Several visual layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, duplicate cards with identical content, and partial category chips cut off at the edge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on tap; ensure card width accommodates typical names.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side by side with the same image, time, and delivery fee, looking like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the list or ensure distinct nearby restaurants are shown; verify API/data binding for this carousel.

issues.description: Category filter chips (e.g. after 'Healthy') are clipped at the right edge with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll padding/fade, a partial next chip, or a chevron so users know more filters exist.

issues.description: Bottom of the pizza promo card and related content are cut off by the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe area so list content is not obscured by the tab bar.
